title: The palette is read from the Omarchy theme at start
body:
`src/server/chrome/palette.rs` is a hardcoded copy of the colours in
`~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/colors.toml` as of 2026-11-06. A theme
switch in Omarchy does not reach decade.

## Proposal

Read that file at start when it exists, falling back to the copied values,
and map its keys to the palette's names one to one. Reloading on a theme
change is a later step; the hooks Omarchy offers for theme-set could restart
or signal decade.
